items.title: Terry McLaurin: Team's leading receiver in return
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring) caught all four of his targets for 62 yards and also caught a two-point conversion in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Early TD helps set season rushing high
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt rushed 11 times for 82 yards and a touchdown but wasn't targeted in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Washington: Compiles 134 all-purpose yards in loss
items.text:
Washington secured six of eight targets for 43 yards, rushed once for 18 yards, returned two kickoffs for 45 yards and ran back one punt for 28 yards in the Dolphins' 31-24 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Warren: Gets into end zone in strong Week 5 effort
items.text:
Warren caught seven of nine targets for 83 yards and added a one-yard touchdown on his only carry in Sunday's 34-22 loss to the Steelers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Can't get ball into end zone in loss
items.text:
Jones completed 24 of 44 passes for 267 yards without a touchdown or interception and added four rushing yards on three carries in Sunday's 34-22 loss to the Steelers.
